handler.configuration: Identical RenderSecured output to the table guards; no secrets.
handler.required: One enabled synchronous handler. No successful result is inferred without ResultCode=Applied.

concurrency: Accept only canonical positive decimal RowVersion or W/"decimal" ETag. Execute UpdateRequest(IfRowVersionMatches) through the caller service inside the synchronous transaction. Validation reads never authorize an unconditional update.
authorization: Exact configured writer must equal both caller and initiating user. Reuse original requester/effective-role/scope/correlation/server-clock/Pending/result-field checks. No system service or impersonation.
errors: Throw safe fault on invalid input, stale state, wrong correlation, origin or scope. ConcurrencyVersionMismatch becomes CONCURRENCY_MISMATCH. Other SDK write faults become RESULT_WRITE_FAILED; never return Applied on fault or retry.
deployment: Register the handler before wiring Flow. Keep Calendar disabled and no Pending creation until table guards and genuine restricted-writer/non-admin-requester runtime acceptance pass.
